In addition, the position is displayed in What3Words (w3w) coordinates.

To switch between satellite image and map view just tap the compass.

You can zoom with the pinch-/spread Gesture or with the slider beneath the Address so that you can orient yourself at certain prominent points.

The blue highlighted area indicates the current accuracy.
